Your account is ready. ECStay helps students and young workers find rooms and bedspaces in Davao City, and helps owners like you get found by them.



How listing works



1. Add your boarding house
Upload photos, set the monthly price and pin the exact spot on the map.

2. We review it
We check every listing before it goes live, and we’ll email you when yours is up.

3. Renters contact you
Inquiries come to your email with the renter’s name and mobile number. Renters pay you directly, after they’ve seen the room.



Add your place: {{site_url}}/host/new



Have a few clear, bright photos of the room ready before you start.
